Name: Recycle Jelly
Author: dfs168
Description:
[b]Why recycle jelly?[/b]

Say you fish more often in the lake or river, you could end up with a lot of river jelly compared to cave jelly and sea jelly. One of each type of jelly is needed to make a new Fish Smoker so it would be nice to trade in your excess for one of the other types of jellies. 

As a fishing enthusiast, you probably already have a few recycling machines lying around so why not use them instead of having to craft yet another type of machine or collect more crafting recipes.

[b]How it works[/b]

This mod uses the Producer Framework Mod to allow you recycle sea jelly, river jelly and cave jelly into a different type of jelly or seaweed/algae in the recycling machine.

- Sea Jelly gets one of River Jelly (30% chance), Cave Jelly (30% chance) or Seaweed (40% chance)
- River Jelly gets one of Sea Jelly (30% chance), Cave Jelly (30% chance) or Green Algae (40% chance)
- Cave Jelly gets one of Sea Jelly (30% chance), River Jelly (30% chance) or White Algae (40% chance)

You have more of a chance of getting a seaweed or algae but if you have plenty of one type of jelly and not enough of another it's worth the risk. It sure beats spending hours (or days) fishing up trash in the mines to maybe end up with one cave jelly!

[b]A note for users of the Automate mod
[/b]
If you put the jelly in your chest with a recycling machine attached it will keep recycling the resulting jelly until you're left with seaweed/algae because each type of jelly is recyclable. So unless you really want seaweed/algae it's best to manually process the jelly through your recycling machine.
